name: Rails Unsafe Reflection via constantize/send
attack_scenario: Attacker sets ?type=Kernel or method=destroy_all; the controller instantiates or calls a class/method it was never meant to, escalating to data loss or code execution.
negative_test_hint: request the endpoint with type param "Kernel" and assert the controller rejects it instead of constantizing an arbitrary class

exemplar.compliant:
ALLOWED = { "post" => Post, "comment" => Comment }
klass = ALLOWED.fetch(params[:type]) { raise ActionController::BadRequest }
exemplar.explanation: constantize/safe_constantize resolve an arbitrary class name from user input and .send/public_send invoke an arbitrary method, letting an attacker reach classes and methods the developer never exposed — a direct path to RCE or auth bypass. Map user input through a fixed allowlist instead.
